content.text: Five seconds, continuous natural real-time live-action shot. EXACTLY TWO soldiers as reference, never add anybody. Both move slowly diagonally RIGHT away from camera on this dirt road. Right wounded soldier keeps left arm over left companion shoulder and drags his right boot slightly; supporting companion keeps right arm around his waist and left hand gripping draped wrist. Preserve these contact points throughout. In five seconds they take just THREE short uneven weighted steps, shoulder and torso bear weight, injured leg never magically heals. The exhausted man briefly sags, companion steadies him without releasing their hold. Camera tracks gently alongside from rear-left at waist height, maintains full bodies and feet, no orbit or showing faces frontally. They approach the foreground right post; post partially occludes them at end. Background canvas tents burn continuously, no explosion, no collapsing beam. Natural strained BREATHING without words, shoe scuffs on dirt, lamellar and cloth friction, nearby fire crackle. NO speech, no shout, no narration, NO music, no BGM, no text. Preserve two bodies and four legs, ordinary real actors, no game character look, no hero slow-motion.
